The head-bobbing style these robots trained themselves to use
caption:
These robots weren't programmed with a running style. They trained themselves until they found one.

At this robot running competition, each machine developed its own unique way of moving through trial and error, with no human deciding the form. The head-bobbing, swaying postures you see are what each robot's AI settled on after thousands of attempts at staying fast and upright. Every robot in the race ended up looking completely different from the others. The lane changes are a bonus.

This is what self-learning actually looks like. Not a human engineer picking the best gait. The machine trying things until something works.
